sources.title: Qwen3.6-Max-Preview: Smarter, Sharper, Still Evolving
sources.evidence: Official announcement dated April 18, 2026 explicitly calls this preview proprietary and describes agentic coding, knowledge, instruction following and preserve_thinking support. Complete indexed article retrieved; index crawl was two months old and direct open returned no text. Its simultaneous coming-soon/available API wording does not establish current service availability.

sources.title: Qwen API platform
sources.evidence: The exact Qwen3.6-Max-Preview card lists text input, text output and a 262,144-token context. Complete indexed page retrieved from a two-month-old crawl; direct open returned no text. These are last-documented specifications, not a current endpoint test.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates (Chinese)
sources.evidence: Live page's international section explicitly lists qwen3.6-max-preview on April 14, 2026, with text generation and deep thinking and a description of its text-only preview capabilities. The China listing is April 20. These are regional release entries, not dates embedded in a snapshot identifier.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: Text generation
sources.evidence: Indexed complete legacy-model table, crawled last month, explicitly lists qwen3.6-max-preview with 256k context, thinking mode, Function Calling and structured output; built-in tools are unsupported. The live October 15 page no longer contains this model's row, so the indexed row establishes documented capabilities rather than current operation.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: English indexed international release history agrees on April 14, 2026; the live page contains the April 20 China entry. It identifies this exact model as the Qwen3.6 Max preview and describes coding-agent, front-end programming and long-tail knowledge improvements.

sources.evidence: Baseline catalog source was opened: it asserts April 20, 2026, 262,144 context, text/text, reasoning, tool calling and closed weights. It is secondary and does not establish architecture or parameter counts.

name.note: Display-name spacing normalizes the official Qwen3.6-Max-Preview name; the preview suffix is essential.

developer.note: The Qwen Team announcement and Alibaba's first-party Qwen documentation identify Alibaba's Qwen model.

family.note: Official lifecycle documentation places the exact preview model in the Qwen3.6 series.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit primary release entry is April 14 for International deployment. April 18 is the Qwen announcement date; April 20 is the later China listing retained by the baseline. This uses earliest documented public availability, not publication date or a dated snapshot.

open_weights.note: Qwen explicitly labels this exact preview proprietary; closed weights are not inferred merely from API hosting.

license.note: No model-weight license identifier is disclosed for this proprietary preview.

parameters_b.note: No total parameter count is disclosed for this exact preview in the inspected primary materials.

active_parameters_b.note: No active parameter count is disclosed; another Qwen Max model's count cannot be transferred.

architecture.note: No exact-preview architecture is disclosed; third-party MoE assertions lack inspected primary support.

context_window.note: Exact token count is explicit on Qwen's indexed API card; Alibaba's legacy capability table corroborates it as 256k. This is documented capacity, not a current endpoint check.

modalities.note: The exact API card states text input and output; the release history explicitly limits this preview to text capabilities.

reasoning.note: Exact legacy row supports thinking mode; the announcement also documents preserving thinking across turns.

tool_call.note: The exact legacy row explicitly supports Function Calling. Its unsupported built-in-tools column is a different capability.

description.value: Proprietary text-only preview in the Qwen3.6 series, with thinking mode and function calling for coding and agentic tasks.
description.note: Replaces the broad flagship wording with the documented preview identity and capabilities.

patch.description: Proprietary text-only preview in the Qwen3.6 series, with thinking mode and function calling for coding and agentic tasks.
patch.notes: Earliest documented release is the International listing on April 14, 2026; the Qwen announcement is April 18 and China listing April 20. The undated preview identifier has no verified immutable checkpoint equivalence. Counts and architecture remain undisclosed. Context and tool support rely partly on complete indexed primary pages whose live content has changed; current endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Correct release date from April 20 to the earliest primary International listing, April 14, and qualify the description as a text-only proprietary preview. Confirm context, modalities, reasoning and function calling from exact-model primary evidence. Keep license, total/active parameters and architecture null. No later Max architecture, counts, multimodal capabilities or context limits were transferred to Preview.
